# Vickhal Roopram (Vick Does Creative)

> Vickhal Roopram (Vick) is a UX/UI, illustration and motion designer in South Africa. UX/UI Designer at Floodlight Studios. Research like a nerd. Play like a kid. Use the box.

The home page (https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/) is a playable 3D cardboard synthesizer that needs JavaScript and WebGL. The same portfolio as plain HTML, with every project, is at https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/.

- Contact: vickhal10@gmail.com (work, projects and collaborations welcome)
- Location: South Africa
- Skills: UX/UI design, Prototyping, Design systems, Motion design, 2D and 3D animation, Illustration, Graphic design, Branding, Packaging design, Design thinking, AI workflow automation, Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, After Effects, Blender, Spline

## Portfolio

- [The whole portfolio on one page](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/): every project, experience, awards, education and contact

## UX/UI design

- [Plug Our Potholes](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#ux-plug-our-potholes): UX/UI case study: a community app, developed with Floodlight Studios, where people report potholes, vote for the next area and donate to fix their own roads.
- [Fleet Receiving](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#ux-fleet-receiving): UX/UI case study: Fleet, a stand-alone receiving system for a distribution centre that tracks every touch point of an offload, so bottlenecks show up.

## Graphic design

- [A Journey With Kal](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#gd-a-journey-with-kal): An illustrated, animated Instagram diary about living with Kallmann syndrome and acromegaly: informative, a bit funny, and shared by people around the world.
- [A Noob’s Guide to Building a PC](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#gd-a-noobs-guide-to-building-a-pc): An 800 × 2000 px infographic of the basic parts of a gaming PC and what each one does.
- [iMvelo Care](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#gd-imvelo-care): Corporate identity for iMvelo, a mobile spa and wellness centre for women that specialises in care for the elderly.
- [Takkie Wash & Squeaky Kleen](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#gd-takkie-wash-squeaky-kleen): Team lead on a rebrand of two cleaning brands for a new in-store partnership, so customers can tell which brand does what.
- [Clover Festive Display](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#gd-clover-festive-display): In-store festive display for Clover and its Win-a-Car promotion, built on Clover’s line “Way Better Shared”.
- [Pulse Hybrid Inverter](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#gd-pulse-hybrid-inverter): Packaging for a backup power inverter that has to sell itself in store. Bronze at the 2020 SA Gold Pack Design Awards and a Top 100 international entry.
- [Saddler Repositioning](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#gd-saddler-repositioning): Repositioning Saddler from a white-label business to an on-trend fashion accessory brand: “Your World. Your Way.”
- [Retro Grade](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#gd-retro-grade): A T-shirt range I designed to celebrate 50-plus years of gaming and esports, and the two-page publication that presents it.
- [Jonsson Workwear: Siyapusha](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#gd-jonsson-workwear-siyapusha): Group lead on the campaign strategy to launch Jonsson’s lifestyle footwear, The Kalahari’s, which drove the launch collateral and a packaging redesign.

## Motion & 3D

- [A Journey With Kal](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#mo-a-journey-with-kal): Short animations about life with two rare genetic disorders, made funny so they're easier to relate to.
- [“Yoh!” in motion](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#mo-yoh-in-motion): A character GIF animated frame by frame in comic halftone, timed so the word lands like a punchline.
- [3D & animation toolkit](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#mo-3d-animation-toolkit): 2D and 3D animation, from personal projects to freelance work. This playable 3D synth is one example.
- [Genesis Printing](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#mo-genesis-printing): Graphic and motion designer, part time (2017–2019): animated promos alongside print-ready production.
- [Church media & production](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#mo-church-media-production): Multimedia engineer and motion designer (2017–2019): live visuals, service graphics and video for Conquering Through Prayer Ministries International.
- [@vicsdoesmotion](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#mo-vicsdoesmotion): My creative Instagram, where animation, illustration and motion experiments get tested in public.

## Experimental

- [VR-17 Portfolio Synth](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#xp-vr-17-portfolio-synth): This portfolio: a playable 3D synthesizer built with Three.js and the Web Audio API, designed in Figma and rebuilt in cardboard.
- [Retro Grade pixel art](https://vick-does-creative.netlify.app/portfolio/#xp-retro-grade-pixel-art): Hand-placed pixel-art characters and scenes from the Retro Grade project.
